posts.text:
What an incredible inspiration and testament to what is possible when we reject cynicism and despair, and instead choose hope and determination.

Video

13 American servicemembers are dead.

More than 200 injured.

Gas prices are surging across America.

And Republicans in Congress can't even muster the courage to hold a single hearing.

Shameful.

🧵⬇️

I've had enough.

My colleagues and I are using every lever of power we have to force this debate in the Senate.

Hegseth and others need to face the American people and answer questions under oath. No more stonewalling.

It's time to end this reckless war and start fighting for Americans here at home—affordable healthcare, childcare, lower energy bills, cheaper groceries, and more money in your pocket.

That’s the fight I want to have.

ICE is completely reckless and out of control.

Video

Joy in the morning.
Joy in the struggle.
Joy in the storm.

Choosing joy is defiance.
Choosing joy is resistance.
Choosing joy is liberation.

In hard times, joy isn’t naive.
It is courageous.
And courage is contagious.

Video

Trump wants to ban ways to for you to vote, but not for himself.

Video

Pay TSA and stop sending ICE agents where they only cause more chaos and confusion.

Video

I could not have said it any better.

Video

The SAVE Act is a threat to the right to vote for millions of Americans – no matter who you vote for.

Video

Democrats are ready to fund TSA, FEMA, and more, but Republicans–who control every branch of government–don’t want to.

Video

Trump’s reckless and unconstitutional war is hurting Americans and the world.

Video

My message to Trump & Vance is clear: pay TSA and get ICE the hell out of our airports.
